versions.changelog:
Adds a Taplio-powered workflow for defining a focused LinkedIn niche.

- Guides users through seven questions, one at a time, to clarify their audience, problem, unique angle, and anti-positioning.
- Uses Taplio profile settings and recent analytics to ground the positioning in current data.
- Produces a niche statement, one-line positioning, alternative phrasings, next steps, and content pillar ideas.
- Requires the Taplio MCP; without it, the skill stops and provides setup instructions.
- Can optionally create a positioning intro post as a draft; it never publishes without explicit user instruction.
